decisions.reason: As a peripheral consumer product with only brief website support and weak fit to the firm's waste and process-technology focus, it is likely to fall below aspiration levels and be dropped so resources can be redirected.

Because it fits the firm's industrial environmental-technology base and was still being mentioned after launch, management would likely tolerate some uncertainty and keep it while results remain close enough to aspiration.

This appears to be a core, prominently launched offering in a related problem domain, so boundedly rational management would likely view it as worth retaining unless clearer evidence of sustained underperformance emerges.

Although strategically related, its shorter and less established market presence suggests performance may be below aspiration, making it a plausible candidate for problemistic reallocation of resources.
